data.one_liner: Flutter text editing controller for styled mentions, debounced user search, and markup.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom text editing controller that detects mention symbols (like '@'), supports debounced user searching, handles mention insertion, and outputs structured markup text.
use_when: You need to add user tagging or mention support to a text input field
You want built-in debounced searching when a user types a mention trigger
avoid_when: You are using a Flutter version older than 3.47
You do not need text editing controllers for structured mentions
strengths: Supports debounced search out of the box
Allows custom mention styling and widget support
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Requires manual disposal of the controller
Requires an external package like flutter_parsed_text to render the mention text
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47 or newer and Dart >=3.13.0 <4.0.0. Call dispose when exiting the screen.
